topic: 供应交付异常的共同核对
contentScope: One original fictional scene and four corresponding thematic icons. No customer documents or user screenshot included.
visualReview: Actual light-background composite inspected; original Alpha retained.
Scene and icons use the same contour/fill/material method, with simpler icon detail.
The scene shows discussion or pending review; no completed approval is asserted.
No rectangular illustration frame or decorative display pedestal.
limitations: One topic/palette/generation per new sheet; no repeated generation or cross-model stability claim.
Four icons are a review row in one image, not four separate deliverables.
Generated color tones and very subtle tonal variations are not exact HEX or flat-fill measurements.
A paired sheet is not an all-size or arbitrary-document validation.
Navy monoline on dark navy has insufficient contrast; this palette example targets light backgrounds. Recolor or regenerate for a dark document.

independentReview.method: Original image plus actual light/dark background diagnostic previews inspected by another agent.
independentReview.scope: One topic; not repeated or arbitrary-document verification.
